description: Read-only discovery for candidate Solana and BNB Chain tokens through the optional token API. The engine returns token_evidence_unavailable when required provider evidence is missing. Contract or mint address is the identity; symbols are display text. Every result remains non-tradeable.

q.description: Symbol, name, or exact contract/mint address, 2-64 characters.

verified_only.description: Require provider-verified identities. Defaults to true; BNB risk data is currently incomplete and therefore excluded by this default.

name: search_tokens
